name: vault-wrap-up
summary: Run an end-of-session vault review: modified files, note quality, indexes, memory updates, and workflow improvements.
done_when: workflow scope is satisfied or explicitly blocked
remaining open work that requires later action, review, decision, approval, or revisit is represented by linked task records
touched files are listed with paths
verification: verify changed Markdown/frontmatter where files were edited
verify wikilinks where notes were created or changed
verify remaining durable open work is task-backed while resolved conversational flow is not unnecessarily taskified
